related_questions.question: How long is the wait for cancer treatment in BC?
related_questions.snippet: As of the end of February 2025, approximately 93% of patients in B.C. were waiting less than four weeks to start their radiation treatment – exceeding the national benchmark of 90%. This is also a 24% improvement since spring 2023, when only 69% of patients were starting treatment within four weeks.

related_questions.question: What is the best cancer center in the US?

text_blocks.snippet: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, Texas, is widely regarded as one of the best cancer centers in the United States. It consistently ranks highly in various rankings, including being named the #1 cancer hospital by U.S. News & World Report.
snippet_highlighted_words: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, Texas

text_blocks.snippet: Here's why MD Anderson is often considered the best:

list.title: Top Ranking:
list.snippet: It has been ranked #1 in cancer care by U.S. News & World Report for many years.

list.title: Comprehensive Care:
list.snippet: MD Anderson is one of the original three comprehensive cancer centers in the United States.

list.title: Research and Innovation:
list.snippet: The center is a leader in cancer research, developing new treatments and therapies.

list.title: Patient Volume and Expertise:
list.snippet: MD Anderson treats over 179,000 patients annually and employs nearly 25,000 people.

list.title: Focus on Prevention:
list.snippet: MD Anderson is also recognized for its work in cancer prevention.

text_blocks.snippet: Other top cancer centers in the US include Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center in New York City and the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, Minnesota. However, MD Anderson consistently receives the highest accolades and is often the first choice for patients seeking specialized cancer care.
